notes: τῶν … παραβάσεων: the article precedes its noun across an interposed prepositional phrase, so it takes the discontinuous 'of the … that' headed on 'the' (rules 31, 57) and the copula 'were' goes to ἐπί.
γενομένου headed on 'place' as the meaning-bearing complement of a support-verb rendering; the competing head 'taken' is named in the unit note.
διὰ τοῦτο → 'For this cause' headed on 'For' per rule 46's contrast, an expressed Greek preposition being present.
